svg.title: A wrapped seam in the 216-piece lizard puzzle
svg.desc: Actual seed 387 paths. The assembled crop spans the right edge of the periodic board. Piece 003 shifted 500 millimetres right meets piece 049 along a single blue cut. The center panel isolates piece 049 and its engraved spine and eyes.
svg.text: Dashed line marks the repeat boundary.
The two pieces share the blue cut.
Piece 003 shifts one period to the right (+500 mm) to meet piece 049. Neighbors are muted in the assembled crop.
All three views use the exported contours and engraving coordinates. Piece numbers are the zero-based generator IDs.
